question is, of
what?!

The answer is the number of
fancy-schmancy
brooches in McQueen's
collection!

text_block_list.text:
That has nothing to do with summer
camp,
though!

text_block_list.text:
You know the drill! As punishment for
answering
incorrectly, you have to walk
back to the
academy! Bye!

text_block_list.text:
I make a beeline for the bus before it
gets a
chance to leave me behind.
